data.one_liner: A Contextual Action Bar workaround for Flutter for item selection and actions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a ContextualScaffold and ContextualAppBar that replace the standard application bar when items are selected, allowing users to perform contextual batch actions. It includes widgets like ContextualActionWidget to easily manage selection states.
use_when: You need a Material Contextual Action Bar (CAB) in Flutter before native support arrives.
You are implementing multi-selection item actions similar to native apps like WhatsApp.
avoid_when: You need zero items in the ActionMode.
Your child widgets need to handle their own onLongPress events for selection.
strengths: Fills a gap in Flutter for Material CAB implementations.
Provides clean abstractions like ContextualScaffold and ContextualActionWidget.
weaknesses: It is a workaround for missing native Flutter features.
Does not support zero items in ActionMode.
data.minimal_example:
ContextualScaffold<?awsze>(
      contextualAppBar: ContextualAppBar(
        counterBuilder: (int itemsCount) => Text("$itemsCount Selected"),
        contextualActions: [],
      ),
      appBar: AppBar(),
      body: Body(),
    )
